claims.title: Exact directed-graph substitution identities isolate two failed triangle-forcing mechanisms

status: source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. Intake checked byte preservation and repository structure; no independent proof reconstruction, scientific-code replay, citation verification, formal proof, quantum circuit execution, or experimental validation was performed. External correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN.
interface: For a strongly connected loopless digraph G with adjacency B, N>=2 and spectral radius r>0, replace each vertex by the transitive tournament T_m and each original arc by all cross-block arcs. The source derives rho(B tensor J_m + I_N tensor T_m)=1/((1+1/r)^(1/m)-1), preservation of directed girth and delta-plus(G[T_m])=m delta-plus(G). For D_m=C4[T_m], rho(D_5)>20/3 although girth=4, and rho(D_m)/(4m)->1/(4 log 2)>1/3. These graphs have minimum outdegree density 1/4: they refute the proposed spectral implication, not Caccetta–Häggkvist. The substitution construction is acknowledged prior mathematics; originality of the calculation is unestablished.
limits: Obtain the named note, verifier and ZIP; independently reconstruct both substitution identities and finite counterexamples. The universal beta(A+I/3)<=1/3 inequality remains open in this account and is equivalent to the original directed-triangle target, not a solved reduction.
